author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಗುರುವಿನೀಕ್ಷಣೆ ಸಾಕು ಜೀವನವ ಬೆಳಗಿಸಲು
ತರತಮವ ಶಿಷ್ಯರಲಿ ಮಾಡದಿಹನವನು
ಅರಿವಿತ್ತು ಅಜ್ಞಾನ ದೂರಮಾಡುತಲಿಹನು
ಗುರುತರದ ಗೂಢವದೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: The Guru's glance alone is enough to light up a life;
he makes no distinction among his disciples;
giving knowledge, he goes on driving ignorance away:
that is the weightiest secret, O deluded one.
en.note: Gurutara, ‘weightiest’, plays on guru, which also means ‘heavy, weighty’.
en.bhavartha: A single glance from the Guru can light up a whole life. He treats every disciple alike, and by giving knowledge he keeps dispelling ignorance. That is the deep secret of the Guru.
